description:
Aggregate the work that delivers this outcome: query filters, auto-transitions and cycle detection are owned by domain and graph tests, with CLI and harness tests reduced to wiring.

## Background

This story groups the test-topology tasks that share one design surface, so they can be reviewed together once each has landed.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Query filters and ordering, dependency auto-transitions and cycle detection are proven only at the domain and graph layers.
- [hard] REQ-02: CLI and harness tests of those commands assert one wiring case per subcommand or flag.
- [hard] REQ-03: The harness demonstration suite no longer exists, and its unique cases live beside their owners.
title: Query, transition and cycle semantics are proven at the domain and graph layers
